meta.name: Pujo Parikrama
meta.disclaimer: Locations and details are curated and approximate. Themes, timings and traffic rules change every year, so check locally.

zones.name: North Kolkata Heritage
zones.vibe: Bonedi bari, Kumartuli artisans, and the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Narrow lanes, deep tradition.
zones.walk_tip: Take the Blue Line to Sovabazar or Shyambazar. The lanes off Rabindra Sarani and Bidhan Sarani are closed to cars most evenings.

zones.name: Central Blockbusters
zones.vibe: Theme giants: Md. Ali Park, College Square and Santosh Mitra Square. Huge queues and huge spectacle.
zones.walk_tip: Use MG Road, Central or Sealdah. Go before 8 am or after 1 am if you want short queues.

zones.name: Gariahat & Ballygunge
zones.vibe: Ekdalia, Singhi Park and Ballygunge Cultural. Classic South Kolkata grandeur with lots of food around.
zones.walk_tip: Park at South City or Quest and walk the Gariahat loop. Gariahat Road becomes one-way after 4 pm.

zones.name: Lake Market & Kalighat
zones.vibe: Tridhara, 66 Pally, Maddox Square, Badamtala and Chetla. The densest cluster in the city.
zones.walk_tip: The Blue Line stations Kalighat, Rabindra Sarobar and Jatin Das Park all drop you right into the cluster. Lake Mall has paid parking.

zones.name: Behala & New Alipore
zones.vibe: Suruchi Sangha, Barisha and Behala Notun Dal. Theme-heavy and a little less crowded.
zones.walk_tip: The Purple Line runs from Taratala to Behala Chowrasta. Cars are fine before 5 pm.

zones.name: Salt Lake Blocks
zones.vibe: FD, BJ and AE Blocks. Wide roads, well organised, family friendly.
zones.walk_tip: Green Line to City Centre. Cars are OK, and City Centre has paid parking.

zones.name: Lake Town & Dum Dum Park
zones.vibe: Sreebhumi and the Dum Dum Park theme row. Insta-famous replicas and art installations.
zones.walk_tip: VIP Road jams up for kilometres around Sreebhumi. Take the metro to Dum Dum and then an auto, or park at Diamond Plaza.

pandals.name: Bagbazar Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: One of the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Traditional daker saaj idol, plus a riverside fair.

pandals.name: Kumartuli Park Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: Next door to the idol-makers' quarter. Expect bold, artistic themes every year.

pandals.name: Kumartuli Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: Worshipped where the idols are born. Walk the artisan lanes on the way.

pandals.name: Ahiritola Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: A riverside neighbourhood puja known for large-scale theme work.

pandals.name: Ahiritola Jubak Brinda
pandals.highlight: A short hop from Ahiritola Sarbojanin, with inventive craft themes.

pandals.name: Sovabazar Rajbari
pandals.highlight: A bonedi bari puja started by Raja Nabakrishna Deb. The thakurdalan is stunning.

pandals.name: Kashi Bose Lane
pandals.highlight: A lane-side puja that keeps winning art awards.

pandals.name: Nalin Sarkar Street
pandals.highlight: A famous Hatibagan theme puja tucked into a narrow lane.

pandals.name: Hatibagan Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: Right at the Hatibagan crossing. Easy to combine with street shopping.

pandals.name: Hatibagan Nabin Pally
pandals.highlight: A smaller theme puja a few minutes from the Hatibagan crossing.

pandals.name: Jagat Mukherjee Park
pandals.highlight: Park-based theme puja near Shyambazar.

pandals.name: Tala Prattoy
pandals.highlight: North Kolkata's blockbuster theme puja. The queue moves fast at dawn.

pandals.name: Mohammad Ali Park
pandals.highlight: A Central Avenue giant known for lavish replicas and theme pandals.

pandals.name: Chaltabagan Lohapatty
pandals.highlight: Theme puja off Bidhan Sarani that regularly picks up awards.

pandals.name: Simla Byayam Samity
pandals.highlight: Historic puja in Swami Vivekananda's neighbourhood.

pandals.name: College Square Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: The lighting reflected on the College Square pond is iconic at night.

pandals.name: Santosh Mitra Square (Lebutala)
pandals.highlight: Known for giant replica pandals (it once built a gold idol and a chariot), so the queues get long.

pandals.name: Sealdah Railway Athletic Club
pandals.highlight: Right next to Sealdah station. Easy to add to the Santosh Mitra visit.

pandals.name: Ekdalia Evergreen
pandals.highlight: A huge traditional idol in a temple-replica pandal. A South Kolkata staple.

pandals.name: Singhi Park
pandals.highlight: Grand traditional puja just off Gariahat Road.

pandals.name: Ballygunge Cultural Association
pandals.highlight: Thoughtful art-led themes in a calm-ish setting.

pandals.name: Hindustan Park Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: An art-college aesthetic, with fewer crowds than its neighbours.

pandals.name: Jodhpur Park
pandals.highlight: Big theme pandal in a residential para.

pandals.name: Babubagan Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: Neighbourhood puja between Dhakuria and Selimpur.

pandals.name: Bosepukur Sitala Mandir
pandals.highlight: Famous for intricate material-based pandals.

pandals.name: Bosepukur Talbagan
pandals.highlight: Bosepukur's other award-winning theme puja.

pandals.name: Maddox Square
pandals.highlight: Kolkata's favourite adda ground. A traditional idol and the city's best people-watching.

pandals.name: Samaj Sebi Sangha
pandals.highlight: An elegant puja on Lake View Road with a long cultural legacy.

pandals.name: Shib Mandir Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: A compact theme puja near Lake Market.

pandals.name: Deshapriya Park
pandals.highlight: Once famous for the biggest Durga idol in the world, it now runs grand themes.

pandals.name: Tridhara Sammilani
pandals.highlight: A South Kolkata showstopper with dazzling theme and light work.

pandals.name: 66 Pally
pandals.highlight: A Kalighat-side theme puja that often has a social message.

pandals.name: Mudiali Club
pandals.highlight: Thoughtful themes with an eco slant near Tollygunge.

pandals.name: Badamtala Ashar Sangha
pandals.highlight: A theme favourite, usually built from unusual materials.

pandals.name: Chetla Agrani Club
pandals.highlight: Celebrity-studded inaugurations and blockbuster themes across Tolly Nullah.

pandals.name: Suruchi Sangha
pandals.highlight: New Alipore's showpiece, famous for themes that bring in the art of a different Indian state each year.

pandals.name: Behala Notun Dal
pandals.highlight: Art-led theme pujas with strong craft work.

pandals.name: Behala Friends
pandals.highlight: A consistent theme puja near Behala Chowrasta.

pandals.name: Behala Sahajatri
pandals.highlight: A smaller Behala theme puja with fewer queues.

pandals.name: Barisha Club
pandals.highlight: Behala's southern anchor, known for detailed themes.

pandals.name: FD Block Salt Lake
pandals.highlight: Salt Lake's biggest crowd puller, with a grand idol and a full-blown mela.

pandals.name: BJ Block Salt Lake
pandals.highlight: A spacious theme pandal with an easy walk from Central Park.

pandals.name: AE Block Salt Lake
pandals.highlight: A relaxed block puja that's good for families.

pandals.name: Sreebhumi Sporting Club
pandals.highlight: Insta-famous replica pandals and huge gold jewellery on the idol. Lake Town gridlocks for hours.

pandals.name: Lake Town Adhibasi Brinda
pandals.highlight: A short walk from Sreebhumi, and much calmer.

pandals.name: Dum Dum Park Bharat Chakra
pandals.highlight: Part of the Dum Dum Park theme row, known for art installations.

pandals.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
pandals.highlight: Theme heavyweight on the Dum Dum Park strip.

pandals.name: Dum Dum Park Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: The traditional stop on the Dum Dum Park strip.

pandals.name: Bhowanipore 75 Pally
pandals.highlight: A Bhowanipore theme puja a short walk from the Jatin Das Park metro.

pandals.name: Telengabagan Sarbojanin
pandals.highlight: Award-winning theme work off the Belgachia–Ultadanga stretch.

pandals.name: Lalabagan Nabankur
pandals.highlight: A compact theme puja that fits well between Tala Prattoy and Shyambazar.

pandals.name: Rajdanga Naba Uday Sangha
pandals.highlight: Kasba's third theme heavyweight, right next to the two Bosepukur pujas.

pandals.name: Behala Ajeya Sanghati
pandals.highlight: A popular Behala theme puja near Barisha.

food.name: Mitra Cafe (Sovabazar)
food.note: A century-old cabin. The kabiraji is the reason you queue.

food.name: Girish Chandra Dey & Nakur Chandra Nandy
food.note: Sandesh royalty since 1844. Sells out by evening.

food.name: Chittaranjan Mistanna Bhandar
food.note: The Shyambazar sweet stop.

food.name: Golbari
food.note: The kosha mangsho at Shyambazar five-point crossing is legendary.

food.name: Allen's Kitchen
food.note: Tiny 1900s cabin. Cutlets are fried in pure ghee.

food.name: Royal Indian Hotel
food.note: Chitpur's Mughlai institution since 1905.

food.name: Putiram
food.note: The College Street breakfast: kochuri and jilipi.

food.name: Paramount
food.note: Sherbet parlour since 1918, on the corner of College Square.

food.name: Indian Coffee House
food.note: Adda under high ceilings on College Street.

food.name: Bhim Chandra Nag
food.note: Home of the ledikeni, a short walk from Santosh Mitra Square.

food.name: Aminia (New Market)
food.note: A classic biryani pit stop in the New Market area.

food.name: Nizam's
food.note: The kathi roll is said to have been born here.

food.name: Vivekananda Park Phuchka
food.note: Often called Kolkata's most famous phuchka. Ask for the tok-jhal-mishti.

food.name: Lake Market Telebhaja Stalls
food.note: Late-night fuel between Tridhara and 66 Pally.

food.name: Balwant Singh's Eating House
food.note: Bhowanipore's milky tea and dhaba-style tadka.

food.name: Kewpie's Kitchen
food.note: A home-style Bengali thali close to Maddox Square.

food.name: Gariahat Mor Street Food
food.note: Cheap and quick, right on the Ekdalia–Singhi Park loop.

food.name: Bhojohori Manna (Ekdalia)
food.note: A Bengali chain started here. Book ahead during puja.

food.name: 6 Ballygunge Place
food.note: An upscale Bengali spread in a heritage house.

food.name: Arsalan (Park Circus)
food.note: A biryani heavyweight on the way north from Gariahat.

food.name: New Alipore Puja Stalls
food.note: The pop-up food row that grows around Suruchi Sangha.

food.name: Behala Chowrasta Stalls
food.note: Street classics at the Behala crossing.

food.name: City Centre 1 Food Court
food.note: Air-conditioned toilets and seats, which is gold during pujo.

food.name: Central Park Mela Stalls
food.note: Mela food near BJ Block.

food.name: Lake Town Footbridge Stalls
food.note: Pop-up stalls along the Sreebhumi queue.

food.name: Dum Dum Park Puja Stalls
food.note: Food row between the Dum Dum Park pandals.

food.name: Bosepukur Puja Food Row
food.note: Pop-up stalls between the two Bosepukur pandals.

food.name: Sakherbazar Puja Food Stalls
food.note: The food row on the Diamond Harbour Road side of Barisha Club.

parking.name: Noapara Metro (Park & Ride)
parking.note: Leave the car here and ride the Blue Line to Shyambazar or Sovabazar.

parking.name: Dum Dum Metro Area (Park & Ride)
parking.note: Ride the metro south, or take an auto to Dum Dum Park.

parking.name: Hatibagan Pay & Park (Bidhan Sarani)
parking.note: Usually closed after 4 pm on the main puja days. Check the KP advisory.

parking.name: Sealdah Station Parking
parking.note: The best car base for Santosh Mitra and Sealdah RAC.

parking.name: New Market Multi-level Parking
parking.note: Walk or take the metro north from Esplanade.

parking.name: Lake Mall (Rashbehari)
parking.note: Right in the Tridhara–Deshapriya–66 Pally cluster. Fills by 6 pm.

parking.name: Forum Mall (Elgin Road)
parking.note: A good base for Maddox Square and Bhowanipore.

parking.name: Quest Mall (Ballygunge Circular Rd)
parking.note: Take a cab or the metro south to the Gariahat cluster.

parking.name: South City Mall
parking.note: The base for Jodhpur Park and Babubagan. A cab to Ekdalia takes about 10 minutes.

parking.name: Behala Bazar Metro (Purple Line)
parking.note: Close to Behala Notun Dal and Sahajatri.

parking.name: New Alipore Police-marked Street Parking
parking.note: Follow the cones. Suruchi Sangha is a 5-minute walk.

parking.name: City Centre 1 Parking
parking.note: Walk to FD Block, or take a short auto to BJ Block.

parking.name: Central Park Salt Lake (Puja Lot)
parking.note: A temporary lot that usually opens on the puja days.

parking.name: Diamond Plaza (Jessore Road)
parking.note: Leave the car here. VIP Road near Sreebhumi stays jammed for hours.

itineraries.name: North Kolkata Heritage Trail
itineraries.blurb: Kumartuli, Bagbazar, the bonedi bari and Hatibagan, finishing with kabiraji at Mitra Cafe.
itineraries.blurb_bn: কুমোরটুলি, বাগবাজার, বনেদি বাড়ি আর হাতিবাগান। শেষে মিত্র ক্যাফের কবিরাজি।

itineraries.name: Central Blockbusters at Dawn
itineraries.blurb: Md. Ali Park and Santosh Mitra Square before the queues wake up, then kochuri at Putiram.
itineraries.blurb_bn: লাইন পড়ার আগে মহম্মদ আলি পার্ক আর সন্তোষ মিত্র স্কোয়ার। তারপর পুঁটিরামের কচুরি।

itineraries.name: South Heavyweights
itineraries.blurb: Chetla, Tridhara, 66 Pally and Maddox, then over to Ekdalia and Singhi Park. Phuchka on the way.
itineraries.blurb_bn: চেতলা, ত্রিধারা, ৬৬ পল্লী, ম্যাডক্স, তারপর একডালিয়া আর সিংহী পার্ক। পথে ফুচকা।

itineraries.name: Behala & New Alipore Theme Trail
itineraries.name_bn: বেহালা ও নিউ আলিপুর থিম পরিক্রমা
itineraries.blurb: Suruchi's state-art theme, then the Behala theme strip by the Purple Line.
itineraries.blurb_bn: সুরুচির রাজ্য-শিল্পের থিম, তারপর পার্পল লাইন ধরে বেহালার থিম পুজো।

itineraries.name: Salt Lake + Lake Town Hop
itineraries.blurb: Family-friendly blocks, then the Sreebhumi spectacle once the evening rush thins.
itineraries.blurb_bn: পরিবারের জন্য সল্টলেকের ব্লক, সন্ধের ভিড় কমলে শ্রীভূমি।

itineraries.name: The All-Nighter: North → South
itineraries.blurb: Only the five-star pandals. Ride the Blue Line between clusters and walk till dawn.
itineraries.blurb_bn: শুধু পাঁচ-তারা পুজো। ব্লু লাইনে চড়ে ক্লাস্টার বদলান, ভোর পর্যন্ত হাঁটুন।
